response.original_title: Linkin Park "The Hunting Party Tour" Beijing / Live at Beijing Workers' Stadium
response.overview: On July 26, 2015, the iconic American rock band Linkin Park performed at the Beijing Workers' Stadium, marking the grand finale of their Chinese tour for "The Hunting Party Tour."  Launched in support of their sixth studio album, The Hunting Party, this concert was part of a historic five-city stadium tour across mainland China—spanning Nanjing, Shenzhen, Shanghai, Chongqing, and Beijing. Jointly presented by Live Nation and YongLe Live, it stands as one of the largest stadium-scale tours ever undertaken by a Western rock band in mainland China.
response.title: Linkin Park "The Hunting Party Tour" Beijing / Live at Beijing Workers' Stadium
